mixes up bit depth with channel count

questions.stem: The case below gives the figures. An audit sample contains 499 values flagged for Nyquist criterion; the reviewer must interpret the entries. Which statement about Nyquist criterion is correct for these values?

options.misconception: Uses half the required rate
Confuses sampling with quantization
Assumes one sample per cycle suffices

options.text: Sample above twice the signal frequency

questions.explanation: Nyquist criterion: To represent a frequency faithfully the sampling rate must exceed twice that frequency, the Nyquist criterion. Option D is correct: Sample above twice the signal frequency. Option A is wrong because it uses half the required rate. Option B is wrong because it confuses sampling with quantization. Option C is wrong because it assumes one sample per cycle suffices.
